notes: General-use flagship for the 128GB Mac (research report 2026-10-10, rank 2): Apache-2.0, MoE 122B total / 10B active, 262144-token native context, native vision.
Most-capable general model that genuinely fits 128GB at >=4-bit; needs the raised GPU wired limit (~114-120GB via iogpu.wired_limit_mb) when served alone.
Capability evidence is vendor-reported only; no independent benchmark entries as of 2026-10.
All three shards are required locally; unsloth dynamic quants are the standard for 100B+ MoE at 4-bit.
Serve at 131072 ctx with q8_0 KV cache (profile qwen3.5-122b); long-context KV on standard attention costs ~10-30GB, so do not extend to 1M without measuring.
Vision requires an mmproj file (mmproj-F16.gguf in the repo); llama_launcher has no mmproj wiring yet, so image input is pending.
Unsloth also publishes UD-Q4_K_XL-class MTP variants for speculative decoding; revisit after the base path validates.
